sources.snippet: BulmaX is a self-modifying transformer equipped with 13 novel subsystems, including dynamic neurogenesis that allows the model to grow new attention heads during training. The model began training with 24 attention heads and autonomously expanded to 396 heads through a process inspired by biological neural development.
